title: Meetings & Presentations
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Dirigir reuniones y presentaciones en inglés con este vocabulario proyectará un liderazgo absoluto.

parts.visual:
Controlando la reunión: 
- Take the floor (Tomar la palabra). 
- Address an issue (Abordar un problema / Tratar un tema). 
- Get sidetracked (Desviarse del tema). 
Ej: We are getting sidetracked. Let's take the floor back to the main agenda and address the budget issue.
parts.audio: Controlling the meeting. Take the floor means to start speaking. Address an issue means to talk about a specific problem. Get sidetracked means to lose focus on the main topic. For example: We are getting sidetracked. Let's take the floor back to the main agenda and address the budget issue.

parts.visual:
Finalizando: 
- Wrap up (Resumir / Concluir / Terminar). 
- Action items (Tareas asignadas al final de la reunión). 
- Any other business / AOB (¿Algún otro asunto?). 
Ej: Let's wrap up the meeting. Here are the action items for next week.
parts.audio: Finishing up. Wrap up means to finish or summarize the meeting. Action items are specific tasks assigned to people. A O B stands for Any Other Business. For example: Let's wrap up the meeting. Here are the action items for next week.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para dirigir la reunión.

questions.question: I'd like to take the ____ to introduce our new marketing strategy. (La palabra / El turno de hablar).
questions.explanation: Take the floor = tomar la palabra.

questions.question: We have a lot to cover today, so let's stick to the ____. (La agenda / El orden del día).
questions.explanation: Stick to the agenda = apegarse a la orden del día.

questions.question: We need to ____ the issue of declining sales immediately. (Abordar / Tratar).
questions.explanation: Address an issue = abordar, tratar un problema.

questions.question: We are getting ____. Let's return to the main topic. (Desviándonos del tema).
questions.explanation: Get sidetracked = desviarse del tema principal.

questions.question: I think we've covered everything. Let's ____ up the meeting. (Terminar / Resumir).
questions.explanation: Wrap up = concluir, terminar o resumir (una reunión/evento).

questions.question: Before we finish, is there any ____ other business? (Algún otro asunto).
questions.explanation: Any other business (AOB) = ¿Algún otro asunto a tratar?

questions.question: Here is the list of ____ items we need to complete by Friday. (Tareas asignadas).
questions.explanation: Action items = tareas o acciones a realizar derivadas de la reunión.

questions.question: I will send you the ____ of the meeting this afternoon. (El acta / El resumen escrito).
questions.explanation: Minutes (of a meeting) = el acta de la reunión.

questions.question: Sarah will ____ the meeting while I am away. (Presidir / Dirigir).
questions.explanation: Chair a meeting = presidir o dirigir una reunión.

questions.question: Can everyone please ____ their microphones? There is a lot of background noise. (Silenciar).
Sorry to ____, but I have a question about the budget. (Interrumpir).
Let's move ____ to the next item on the agenda. (Pasar a).
To ____ up, our profits have increased by 15%. (Resumiendo).
questions.explanation: To sum up = en resumen, resumiendo.

questions.question: Could you please ____ that point? I didn't understand. (Aclarar / Explicar más).
I agree with you ____ a certain extent, but not completely. (Hasta cierto punto).
questions.explanation: To a certain extent = hasta cierto punto.

questions.question: Let me ____ the screen so you can see the presentation. (Compartir).
We need to ____ a meeting to discuss the new project. (Fijar / Agendar).
questions.explanation: Schedule a meeting = agendar una reunión.

questions.question: Does anyone have any input they would like to ____? (Añadir).
I think we are going around in ____. We are not deciding anything. (Dando vueltas en círculos).
questions.explanation: Go around in circles = dar vueltas en círculos sin avanzar.

questions.question: Thank you all for ____ today. Have a great weekend. (Asistir).
questions.explanation: Attend = asistir (a un evento o reunión).

stages.title: Written Expression

questions.question: Take the ____. (Tomar la palabra con F)

Let's ____ up. (Resumir/Terminar con W)
____ items. (Tareas a realizar con A)
The ____ of the meeting. (El acta escrita con M plural)
To ____ a meeting. (Presidir con C)
To ____ the screen. (Compartir con S)
Thank you for ____. (Asistir con A terminación ing)
